name: catdoll-micro-frontend
description: A micro-frontend application built with single-spa, React, and Vue 3

scripts.install:all: pnpm install && cd single-spa/main && pnpm install && cd ../react-app && pnpm install && cd ../vue3-app && pnpm install
scripts.start: concurrently "pnpm run start:main" "pnpm run start:react" "pnpm run start:react2"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:vue
